situations.title: 복용 약물·시간 문진
situations.tagline: I took some pills a while ago but I'm not sure how many.
situations.brief: 무엇을·얼마나·언제 복용했는지 핵심 3요소를 차분히 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: What exactly did you take, and do you have the bottle with you?
About how many did you take, and how long ago?
Did you take anything else along with it?

situations.title: 활성탄 투여 설명
situations.tagline: That black liquid looks awful — do I really have to drink it?
situations.brief: 활성탄의 적응·금기와 협조 필요성을 이해하기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This charcoal binds the medicine so your body absorbs less of it.
It's important to drink it now while it can still help.
Tell me right away if you feel like you might throw up.

situations.title: 의도성 여부 초기 사정
situations.tagline: It was an accident, I just took too many by mistake.
situations.brief: 자·타의 여부를 비판단적으로 부드럽게 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I need to ask — were you trying to hurt yourself?
You're safe here, and I won't judge you for anything you tell me.
Have you had thoughts like this before today?

situations.title: 가정 화학물질 노출
situations.tagline: I mixed two cleaners and now my throat is burning.
situations.brief: 제품·노출 경로를 확인하고 독극물센터 자문 절차를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Which products did you mix, and did you breathe in the fumes?
Did any of it get in your eyes or on your skin?
I'm calling Poison Control so we treat this exactly right.

situations.title: 소아 우발 섭취
situations.tagline: I found her with the pill bottle open — I don't know how many she ate.
situations.brief: 보호자에게서 섭취 물질·추정량·시각을 침착하게 이끌어내세요.
keyPhrases: How many pills were in the bottle before, and how many are left now?
About what time did you find her?
You did the right thing bringing her in quickly.

situations.title: 아세트아미노펜 과다
situations.tagline: I took a whole bottle of Tylenol last night — I feel fine now though.
situations.brief: 섭취 시각 기준 혈중농도와 NAC 치료의 시급성을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Feeling okay now is normal, but the danger can show up later.
We'll check your acetaminophen level based on the exact time you took it.
This antidote called NAC protects your liver, and starting it early matters.
goals: 섭취 시각 기준 농도 평가의 중요성을 설명한다

situations.title: 오피오이드 과다
situations.tagline: He's barely breathing — I found him blue on the couch.
situations.brief: 호흡저하를 사정하고 날록손 투여와 재중독 위험을 대응·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving him naloxone now to reverse the opioid.
He may wake up but slip back, so we'll watch him closely.
What did he take, and do you know how much?
goals: 날록손 투여 후 재중독을 지속 감시한다

situations.title: 벤조 과다
situations.tagline: She took a bunch of her Xanax and now I can't keep her awake.
situations.brief: 진정 수준과 기도를 사정하고 플루마제닐 사용의 주의점을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to check how deeply she's sedated and protect her airway.
We're cautious with the reversal drug because it can trigger seizures.
Has she taken any other pills or alcohol with this?

situations.title: 살리실산 중독
situations.tagline: My ears are ringing and I can't stop breathing fast.
situations.brief: 이명·과호흡을 인지하고 요 알칼리화의 목적을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The ringing in your ears is a clue that the aspirin level is high.
We'll give you fluids with bicarbonate to help clear it faster.
How many aspirin did you take, and over how long?

situations.title: TCA 과다
situations.tagline: I took all my old antidepressants — my heart feels like it's racing weird.
situations.brief: QRS 확대를 감시하고 중탄산 투여와 급변 대비를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We're watching your heart rhythm very closely right now.
This bicarbonate helps protect your heart from the medication.
Exactly which pills did you take, and when?

situations.title: 항응고제 과다
situations.tagline: I doubled up on my warfarin by mistake and now my gums are bleeding.
situations.brief: 출혈 위험을 사정하고 역전제 투여 계획을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll check your INR to see how thin your blood is right now.
There's a reversal medicine we can give if the bleeding gets worse.
Are you seeing any blood in your urine or stool, or bruising anywhere?

situations.title: 자살시도 다약제
situations.tagline: I just wanted it all to stop — I took everything in the cabinet.
situations.brief: 다약제 섭취를 파악하고 정신과 협진·1:1 관찰을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear how much pain you're in, and I'm staying right here with you.
Can you tell me each thing you took so we can keep you safe?
A counselor will come see you, and someone will stay with you the whole time.

situations.title: 알코올+약물 혼합
situations.tagline: I had a lot to drink and took my sleeping pills too — I feel so out of it.
situations.brief: 약물 상호작용을 고려하고 의식 수준을 지속 감시·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Alcohol and those pills together can slow your breathing, so we'll watch you closely.
How much did you drink, and how many pills did you take?
Stay with me — I'll keep checking on you every few minutes.

situations.title: 일산화탄소 중독
situations.tagline: The whole family had headaches all morning — the furnace has been acting up.
situations.brief: 두통 병력과 SpO2 오판 위험을 설명하고 산소 치료를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: A regular oxygen reading can look normal even with carbon monoxide, so we use a special test.
I'm putting you on high-flow oxygen to clear it from your blood.
Was anyone else in the house feeling sick too?

situations.title: 약물 은폐 환자
situations.tagline: I didn't take anything, I just feel dizzy. Why are you asking me all this?
situations.brief: 회피적 태도에 대응하며 객관적 단서로 중독 가능성을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm not here to get you in trouble — I just want to keep you safe.
Some of your signs tell me your body reacted to something. Can we talk about it?
Whatever you tell me stays between us and your care team.

situations.title: 미상 물질 의식불명
situations.tagline: Found unresponsive with pinpoint pupils and shallow breathing.
situations.brief: 톡시드롬 단서를 종합하고 기도확보를 우선하며 팀에 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Pupils are pinpoint and respirations are eight — this looks like a toxidrome.
I need airway support and naloxone at the bedside now.
Unknown ingestion, GCS 6, protecting the airway — can you take report?

situations.title: 유기인계 중독
situations.tagline: He was spraying pesticide all day and now he's drooling and shaking.
situations.brief: 콜린성 위기를 인지하고 아트로핀·PAM 투여를 대응·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: These signs — drooling, sweating, tearing — point to organophosphate poisoning.
We're giving atropine to dry up his secretions and protect his breathing.
We need to remove his clothes and wash his skin to stop more from absorbing.

situations.title: 세로토닌 증후군
situations.tagline: I added a new pill this week and now I'm burning up and my muscles keep twitching.
situations.brief: 고열·강직·자율신경 항진을 인지하고 원인 약물과 대응을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The twitching and high fever suggest your medications are interacting.
We're stopping the trigger and cooling you down right away.
Which new medication or supplement did you start this week?

situations.title: 청산/메탄올 중독
situations.tagline: I drank something from an unlabeled bottle in the garage — now I can barely see.
situations.brief: 해독제와 응급 투석의 필요성을 설명하고 신속히 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Trouble seeing after drinking that can mean methanol poisoning.
There's an antidote we're giving now, and you may need urgent dialysis.
How much did you drink, and about how long ago?
goals: 시야 이상을 독성 알코올 중독으로 인지한다

situations.title: 과다복용 심정지 전조
situations.tagline: My chest feels weird and my heart is skipping — I took too much of my heart pills.
situations.brief: 부정맥 전조를 감시하고 소생 대비를 팀에 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Your rhythm is unstable, so we're preparing everything to support you.
Stay with me and tell me right away if it gets worse.
Overdose with widening QRS and bradycardia — I need the crash cart and a physician now.

situations.title: 중독 이송 중 급변 인계
situations.tagline: Patient was stable at pickup but dropped his pressure en route.
situations.brief: 섭취물·시간선을 포함해 급변 경위를 받는 팀에 명확히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Ingestion was tricyclics about ninety minutes ago per the family.
He was talking at pickup but became hypotensive and drowsy en route.
Last pressure was eighty over forty, and I gave a bicarb bolus.
